description: Mailing-list search, keyword (BM25 over the authors' own words) and semantic (embeddings) blended per thread, over every list unless inbox names one or more. Returns up to limit threads (default 20, max 50), best first, each its best message: inbox, message_id, subject, from, date, thread_id, fused_score (0-1), similarity and a short excerpt of the author's own words. Like a ranked `git log --grep` for mail. Cite as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>; read with get_thread or get_message (inbox from the result). author, since and until restrict both arms to one sender and a date window. Takes search's operators. Echoes operators applied, warnings for dropped ones, skipped if mail is excluded; a query that cannot run is an error. complete=false when the keyword arm ran out of budget_ms or a total is a lower bound. A query that is one commit's SHA (7-40 hex) returns the mail that refers to it (Discussion: thread, committers announcement, mail citing the hash; how_it_refers on each) and commit.

author.description: Only mail this person sent: name, address or hash:<8 hex>; every address they use. An ambiguous name returns the candidates

inbox.description: "all" (default), one list (pgsql-bugs) or several, comma-separated; names from list_inboxes

keyword_weight.description: Weight for keyword results in the fusion, 0.0-1.0 (default 0.65). Raise it for exact identifiers (function names, GUCs, error text); lower it to lean on semantic similarity.

query.description: Words or a question. Operators: after:/before:YYYY[-MM[-DD]], d:A..B, site:<list|docs|wiki|commits>, from:/author:, intitle:/s:, intext:/b:, to:/cc:, filetype:patch, has:patch, link:<url glob> (link:host = any URL there), /regex/ (case:yes), -operator negates. Operators alone list newest first.

since.description: On or after (UTC): YYYY[-MM[-DD]], ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago

until.description: Before (exclusive), same forms as since. With author: what they had said by then

name: hybrid_search
